A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the collision-free configuration-spaces are non-convex, and the volume of the collision-free region decreases with the increase in the number of molecules in the asymmetric unit, and the number of molecules that are in contact with each other in the crystal.
the volume of the realizable region of motion space is given by the volume of a polyhedron whose edges are the vectors between the centers of mass of the molecules in the asymmetric unit.

the volume of the collision-free configuration space is the volume of the configuration space minus the volumes of the regions that correspond to the non-realizable configurations, and that the volumes of the non-realisable configuration spaces are given by the volumes of the intersections of the regions of non-realizable configurations with the regions corresponding to the realizable configurations.

the volume of the physically unrealizable region in the configuration space is very small compared to the total configuration space.
